svg.aria-label: Panel A contrasts a conventional U-Net, whose skip links keep every layer's buffer in memory, with a skip-free dilated network that streams one active buffer and frees the rest. Panel B plots illustrative gains on a log scale: a streaming model uses 12 times fewer parameters than a U-Net, runs 8 to 25 times faster, and needs 20 to 30 times less peak memory; streamed preprocessing uses 120 times less heap and runs 3 to 9 times faster; a streamed 4D pipeline needs 3 times less peak memory.
